It is difficult to see how any alleged custom could modify the re-quirements of law as to what a "document of tit:e" is or what a parti-cular contract is or what a particular delivery order means. It could
not help a legally defective document to overcome the basic legal
defect due to its terms. It could not override the specific terms of

statutory provisions as well as the specific terms of the contract bet-ween the parties. An alleged custom, amounting to ignoring or

montioned in a'ny contract are usually annexed to contracts of that des-cription" to be proved. Annexing usage or custom to the express
